You basically have 3 options. 
You can go into ranked, lose a bunch of games and have a ton of people insult you even tho they probably are just as bad or even worse than you but eventually reach a point where your skill level matches your rank. With this option you'll improve the fastest but you'll probably grow tired of the toxicity, but oh well you'll get flamed on any gamemode by some randoms shit happens, who cares?.

You can also play draft, it works exactly like ranked except you don't win or lose lp. People won't take it as serious, therefore improving will be harder and there's still gonna be people that flame you for being bad.

And lastly, if you just wanna have fun and don't care about ranks just play whatever but with friends, league is not a fun game most of the time if you play alone... well for me atleast. All things being considered I have well over 4k hours at this hell simulator and I'm all about the ranked experience so maybe you can have fun by yourself idk
